from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import hashlib,json,re,statistics
root=Path('/home/andrew-peterson/.codex/worktrees/stdlib-foundation/laniusc')
p=root/'tests/fixtures/stdlib_compiler_state/caller-contract-snapshots'
def read(name): return json.loads((p/name).read_text())
def save(name,value): (p/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
sources=read('frozen-sources.json')
changed=[f for f,h in sources.items() if not (root/f).is_file() or sha(root/f)!=h]
assert not changed,changed
(p/'final-sources.json').write_bytes((p/'frozen-sources.json').read_bytes())
shaders=root/'target/stdlib-perf/build/laniusc-shader-artifacts/release/shaders'
shader_hashes=read('current-shader-hashes.json')
changed=[f for f,h in shader_hashes.items() if not (shaders/f).is_file() or sha(shaders/f)!=h]
assert not changed,changed
suites={}
for name,count in [('snapshot',2),('regression',12),('native',2)]:
 d=read(name+'.json');assert d['exit_code']==0 and d['frozen_sources_unchanged'] and len(d['passed'])==count,d
 d.update(source_snapshot='final-sources.json',shader_snapshot='current-shader-hashes.json')
 save(name+'.json',d);suites[name]=d
limitations=read('performance-contracts/comparison.json')['baseline_limitations']
comparisons={}
for directory in ['performance-final','performance-contracts-final']:
 runs=[json.loads(x.read_text()) for x in sorted((p/directory).glob('[0-3]-*.json'))]
 assert len(runs)==4 and all(x['exit_code']==0 and x['output_verified'] and x['sources_unchanged'] and x['shader_link_restored'] and len(x['samples_ms'])==10 for x in runs)
 medians={v:statistics.median([n for x in runs if x['version']==v for n in x['samples_ms']]) for v in ['baseline','current']}
 comparison={'runs':runs,'pooled_median_ms':medians,'current_change_percent':100*(medians['current']/medians['baseline']-1),'source_snapshot':'final-sources.json','baseline_limitations':limitations}
 save(directory+'/comparison.json',comparison);comparisons[directory]={k:v for k,v in comparison.items() if k!='runs'}
profile=read('profile-contracts-final/1-current.json')
assert profile['exit_code']==0 and profile['output_verified'] and profile['sources_unchanged'] and profile['shader_link_restored']
profile['readback_counts']=dict(Counter(re.findall(r'\[gpu-progress\] map.start :: (.+)',(p/'profile-contracts-final/1-current.log').read_text())))
profile['total_readbacks']=sum(profile['readback_counts'].values())
profile['source_snapshot']='final-sources.json'
save('profile-contracts-final/1-current.json',profile)
save('profile-contracts-final/comparison.json',{'baseline':read('profile-contracts/comparison.json')['runs'][0],'unbatched':read('profile-contracts/comparison.json')['runs'][1],'prefetch':read('profile-contracts-optimized/1-current.json'),'final':profile,'warning':'Instrumented timing changes scheduling. Compare map counts here; use the uninstrumented paired runs for latency.'})
manifest={'status':'16 selected correctness checks pass; program-catalog selection/replay evidence remains unimplemented','suites':{n:len(d['passed']) for n,d in suites.items()},'source_snapshot':'final-sources.json','source_files':len(sources),'shader_snapshot':'current-shader-hashes.json','shader_files':len(shader_hashes),'unchanged_sources_and_shaders':True,'performance':comparisons,'profile_readbacks':profile['total_readbacks'],'supported_execution_target':'GPU compiler emits x86_64 Linux ELF. User-program GPU execution not established.','pending':['program-catalog implementation coherence and selection','owned selected evidence and forwarding into imported body replay','generic implementations/prerequisites','generic trait methods and method where clauses','direct constant trait operands'],'baseline_limitations':limitations}
save('verification.json',manifest)
for source,target in [('/tmp/lanius-contract-heavy-final-perf.py','performance-contracts-final-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-contract-final-perf.py','performance-final-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-contract-final-profile.py','profile-contracts-final-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-contract-verify.py','verification-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-contract-finish.py','finish-runner.txt')]:
 (p/target).write_bytes(Path(source).read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
